hook: The most generous player in sports history is also the best one.
story: His name is Wayne Gretzky: Canadian, four Stanley Cups with the 1980s Edmonton Oilers, known simply as The Great One. In hockey you score points two ways: a goal for yourself, or an assist, a goal you create and hand to a teammate. Gretzky's career: 894 goals, and 1,963 assists. The number two scorer in the sport's entire history, Jaromir Jagr, finished with 1,921 - goals and assists together.
number: The gifts alone - 1,963 goals Gretzky handed to other people - outnumber everything Jagr ever did. Erase every goal The Great One scored himself, and he is still the highest scorer in history. He could have done it alone: his 92 goals in one season remain the record. He preferred to assist.
closer: No one has worn his number, 99, in the league since. No one ever will.
full_text: The most generous player in sports history is also the best one. His name is Wayne Gretzky: Canadian, four Stanley Cups with the 1980s Edmonton Oilers, known simply as The Great One. In hockey you score points two ways: a goal for yourself, or an assist, a goal you create and hand to a teammate. Gretzky's career: 894 goals, and 1,963 assists. The number two scorer in the sport's entire history, Jaromir Jagr, finished with 1,921 - goals and assists together. The gifts alone - 1,963 goals Gretzky handed to other people - outnumber everything Jagr ever did. Erase every goal The Great One scored himself, and he is still the highest scorer in history. He could have done it alone: his 92 goals in one season remain the record. He preferred to assist. No one has worn his number, 99, in the league since. No one ever will.
